title: aidentyack.com built from the site Daniel designed

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-23 13:59Z: "This isn't the home page we designed", then 14:04Z with the Claude Design export "Aiden Tyack Website.html" attached.

detail: LIVE-2517 rebuilt aidentyack.com to the handoff zip's ui_kits/site starter screen, which is placeholder copy. Daniel's designed site is the Claude Design file he exported (Aiden Tyack Website.html): six pages in his words. lib/sites/kits/aiden-tyack-site.ts (`aiden-tyack-site`, private, registered with no join page) holds them: Home (forest hero with the rider portrait, the pinned Brass Stud Cuff print and the turning seal; Belts & Bracelets with tabs, count and price sort; the Worn hard photo band; How it's made in stitched cards; the custom work split; Talk to the Workshop with a topic box), Shop, Custom, The Maker, Care and Contact. New on the shared role blocks, all off unless set so every other site renders as before: the hero's pinned print and seal (cardImage, cardLabel, cardPrice, cardHref, seal), a photo crop (focus) on hero, shop, gallery and story photos, the shop's filters switch (components/page-editor/blocks/role-shop.tsx) with a material line and category per product, the story's buttons and photo side, the FAQ's show-every-answer switch and button, and the contact form's topics. The Aiden Tyack skin matches the file: the 1320px column plus gutters, the sticky glass header with the menu split round the lockup, Anton numerals, the design's 7/5 stitch dash on photos, buttons and rules, photo bands, and the footer's two small lines. The design's black cuff is renamed the Harbor Cuff (house word list). Not reproduced: the cart and search icons (the store is dark for launch), the custom brief's material pickers (the brief is the contact form with order types), and the design's product quick view.
